summary: GoldMining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended August 31, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications, all dated October 14, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic reporting event, not a special situation. It discloses a net loss of C$14.48 million for the quarter, cash of C$16.68 million, short-term investments of C$30.26 million and long-term investments of C$99.32 million, with no transaction, tender, activist, strategic-review or capital-return terms stated. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, break fee or close date is present; there is no deal to arbitrage.
